name: Oracle Database
description: Oracle Database is a multi-model database management system produced and marketed by Oracle Corporation. It is designed to store and retrieve large amounts of data, providing high performance, scalability, and reliability for enterprise applications. Oracle Database supports SQL as a query language and offers features such as data warehousing, online transaction processing, and data security.
